items.title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
items.summary: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.

items.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
items.summary: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

items.title: SEC enforcement actions fall 24%, crypto cases in spotlight
items.summary: The SEC filed 348 actions in fiscal 2026, down from 456 a year earlier. Cases included alleged Bitcoin mining fraud and an FTX audit settlement.

items.title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
items.summary: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

items.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
items.summary: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

items.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
items.summary: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

items.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
items.summary: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin remains under pressure as CoreWeave, Nvidia lead AI rebound
items.summary: The DRAM ETF jumps 8% and semiconductor stocks gain more than 4%, while bitcoin continues to test its 200-day moving average.

items.title: Bitcoin barely flinches at hot CPI as ETF selling slows
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 11, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
items.summary: Bitcoin held steady near $74,000 as Tuesday's hot inflation figure lifted the odds on a U.S. interest-rate increase to around 90%. ETF outflows extended to a fourth day and liquidations jumped.

items.title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion
items.summary: Payward says xStocks holds over $1.1 billion. Each token is backed by a share but gives no ownership of the underlying company.

items.title: Bitcoin stuck under $74,000 as CoreWeave earnings revive AI outlook, Anthropic said to raise IPO valuation
items.summary: CoreWeave’s revenue surge lifted AI infrastructure stocks and Nasdaq futures, while bitcoin was little changed over 24 hours.

items.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
items.summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
items.summary: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
items.summary: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

items.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
items.summary: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

items.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
items.summary: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

items.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
items.summary: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

items.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
items.summary: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.
